name: pi05_phase_interpolation_v1

interpolation.tli_layers: native post-block outputs0..16, consumed by subsequent blocks1..17; final output17 is captured but not injected
interpolation.oracle_schedule: alpha=clip(zero_based_policy_call_index/lambda_calls,0,1); paper lambda14 for wine-to-bowl, released per-task lambdas elsewhere
interpolation.library: nine standard training donor tasks used by the published oracle mappings; Astra receives the nine prompts but not target-to-donor oracle mappings

noise.reference: same-condition inverse of policy-generated full internal trajectory
noise.reuse: fixed recovered noise throughout every interpolation rollout; random_noise uses matched rank8 perturbations

vision.expiry: expire at next policy replan; refresh only on successful scheduled Astra decision

feedback.current_frames: up to four recent unmodified policy observations including the current step
feedback.previous_rollout: last completed attempt's four raw paired snapshots, decisions, and outcome

stopping: Each arm starts with the same recovered-noise baseline. On failure, oracle has one interpolation rollout; random and Astra have two. Stop at first success. Within a rollout, rejected calls consume a decision slot; retain valid language, expire vision, and do not retry. A prior successful baseline needs no intervention in evaluation.
claim_scope: Exploratory online rescue with simulator reset access on20 known OOD task compositions and new seed29 resets; development uses3 previously inspected seed19 tasks. Restricted donor library and unknown checkpoint training overlap preclude a held-out or zero-shot generalization claim. No gain is attributed to redundant inversion.
